title: Love Me Like You Do

cues.en: You're the light, you're the night
cues.zh: 你是光芒，你是黑夜
cues.text: You're the light, you're the night

cues.en: You're the color of my blood
cues.zh: 你是我血液的顏色

cues.en: You're the cure, you're the pain
cues.zh: 你是解藥，你是痛苦
cues.text: You're the cure, you're the pain

cues.en: You're the only thing I wanna touch
cues.zh: 你是我唯一想碰的東西

cues.en: Never knew that it could mean so much, so much
cues.zh: 從來不知道這可能意味著這麼多，這麼多

cues.en: You're the fear, I don't care
cues.zh: 你就是恐懼，我不在乎

cues.en: 'Cause I've never been so high
cues.zh: 因為我從未如此興奮

cues.en: Follow me to the dark
cues.zh: 跟著我走向黑暗
cues.text: Follow me to the dark

cues.en: Let me take you past our satellites
cues.zh: 讓我帶你經過我們的衛星
cues.text: Let me take you past our satellites

cues.en: You can see the world you brought to life, to life
cues.zh: 你可以看到你帶來的生活，生活的世界
cues.text: You can see the world you brought to life, to life

cues.en: So love me like you do, lo-lo-love me like you do
cues.zh: So love me like you do, lo-lo-love me like you do

cues.en: Love me like you do, lo-lo-love me like you do
cues.zh: 像你一樣愛我，像你一樣愛我
cues.text: Love me like you do, lo-lo-love me like you do

cues.en: Touch me like you do, to-to-touch me like you do
cues.zh: 像你一樣觸控我，像你一樣觸控我
cues.text: Touch me like you do, to-to-touch me like you do

cues.en: What are you waiting for?
cues.zh: 你還在等什麼？

cues.en: On the edge of paradise
